purpose: The composer of a generative AI chat (ChatGPT, Claude.ai and Gemini composers, AI Elements PromptInput, Cloudscape prompt input): a text area that grows with the prompt up to `maxRows`, a toolbar under it, files attached by a button, by dropping them on the box or by pasting them, a model and mode picker, dictation, a voice-conversation control that stands in for Submit while the prompt is empty, a Submit control that becomes Stop while a response is generated, a secondary row under the box (a context picker, tools, links), an optional character limit with a counter, and constraint text under it all. Enter submits on a fine pointer; Shift+Enter adds a line; on a coarse pointer (a phone keyboard) Enter adds a line and Submit sends; an IME composition never submits. It is controlled: the owner holds the text and the files, receives `submit` with the trimmed prompt, its references and its files, and clears them. While `status` is `pending` or `streaming` the reader can keep typing the next prompt, but cannot submit it until the response ends or they press Stop. With `queueable` the owner keeps a queue of prompts to send after the response (TanStack AI `useChat` queues a `sendMessage` made while it streams): Submit then stays beside Stop, and Enter or Submit sends the next prompt into that queue while Stop still ends the response. The anatomy is composed by the app: the root draws the box, the text area, Submit / Stop / voice and the file tokens; the controls the app wants (attach, dictate, model, context, tools) are sub-components it places in the `actions`, `end` and `footer` slots. Each reads the composer through `provide` / `inject`, so the app wires nothing but its own values.
useWhen: The input of any conversation with the generative AI assistant.
A single "Ask about this page" box that opens a conversation.
avoidWhen: A text field in a form → `textarea` inside `field`.
Search over a list → `input` with a search icon or `property-filter`.
A file upload form → `file-dropzone` with `file-token-group` in a `field`.
related: `textarea` — the form control; this one has no visible label and submits on Enter.
`conversation` — the log above it; only the log scrolls.
`suggestion-group` — prompts the reader can send without typing.
`file-token-group` — what the attached files render as (horizontal, removable).
`file-dropzone` — the drop target for a page-wide drop; the composer box is its own drop target.
`dropdown-menu` — what the model, context and tools pickers open.
`select` (`variant="ghost"`) — a plain single choice the app adds to the toolbar itself.
